sloka: वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातः स्वकर्मनिरतः सदा।स्त्रियाः कस्माद्वधं वीर मन्यसे राक्षसेश्वर ।। ६.९३.६३ ।।
transliteration: vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ svakarmanirataḥ sadā।striyāḥ kasmādvadhaṁ vīra manyase rākṣaseśvara ।। 6.93.63 ।।

translations.english: "You being the direct brother of Kubera (one of the guardians of the world), ten head Lord desires to seek Vaidehi in fury and kill her casting righteousness?"
